source: Own measurement, 2026-11-25, on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/episodes.json: draw 1, 12 episodes, 2 per unit) with this build's grader: the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) through the pinned engine (vendor/ale bfb7505), five ale validate runs: validate-71a5724d, validate-df7ace01, validate-0f3cc3a0, validate-4bc34a7f and validate-9f83534c.
